title:
Epic that updates {@link UiGeospatialAssetsMap#mapVisualization} based on the selected visualization type.

Expected payload:
- `mapId`: The {@link UiGeospatialAssetsMap} component id.
- `value`: List of {@link UiGeospatialAssetsMapVisualizationType} values. (We only use the first one)
name: GeospatialChangeVisualizationTypeEpic
